item.title: Murphy scores 21, Fears 20 as Pelicans send the Kings to their 13th consecutive loss, 120-94
item.description: Trey Murphy III made five 3-pointers and finished with 21 points, Jeremiah Fears scored 14 of his 20 in the second half and the New Orleans Pelicans sent the Sacramento Kings to their 13th straight loss, 120-94.

item.title: Sensabaugh hits late 3-pointer to lift Jazz to 115-111 win over Heat
item.description: Brice Sensabaugh made a go-ahead 3-pointer with 47 seconds remaining to lift the Utah Jazz to a 115-111 victory over the Miami Heat.

item.title: Port Jefferson couple dead in apparent murder-suicide, the police say
item.description: Officers responding to a wellness check found the couple dead of gunshot wounds, the Suffolk County police said.

item.title: Lamar Wilkerson scores 41 as Indiana hands Oregon 10th straight loss, 92-74
item.description: Lamar Wilkerson had 41 points and Indiana beat Oregon 92-74, handing the Ducks a 10th straight loss.

item.title: 76ers star Joel Embiid sits out against Trail Blazers to rest right knee after an off day
item.description: Philadelphia 76ers star Joel Embiid did not play against the Portland Trail Blazers to rest his right knee after an off day.

item.title: No. 9 Kansas beats top-ranked and previously undefeated Arizona 82-78
item.description: Flory Bidunga had a double-double and No. 9 Kansas defeated top-ranked and previously unbeaten Arizona 82-78 on Monday night.

item.title: Louisville's Brown has record-setting game, passing Flagg's ACC mark, tying Hall of Famer Unseld
item.description: Clearly aware he had a hot hand, Mikel Brown Jr. wanted to see what scoring heights he could reach before cooling off.

item.title: US immigration court blocks deportation of Tufts graduate student from Turkey, her attorneys say
item.description: An immigration court has blocked the deportation of a Turkish Tufts University student who was detained by immigration officials near her Massachusetts home last year.

item.title: In China, consumerism trumps nationalism despite tensions with the U.S. and Japan
item.description: Chinese consumers are prioritizing quality and value over patriotism, regardless of how testy relations become in recent diplomatic spats with countries like Japan and the United States.

item.title: Mikayla Blakes scores 34 in No. 5 Vanderbilt women's dominant win over No. 10 Oklahoma
item.description: Mikayla Blakes scored 34 points as No. 5 Vanderbilt beat No. 10 Oklahoma 102-86.
